scripts.text:
Declare @MinDate DATETIME = @0
Declare @MaxDate DATETIME = @1

SET @MinDate = Case When @MinDate  = '1/1/1900' Then DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, -1, getdate()) - 2, 0) Else @MinDate END  

SET @MaxDate  = Case When @MaxDate  = '1/1/1900' Then DATEADD("d", -DAY(GETDATE()), DATEADD("m", 0, GETDATE()))
Else @MaxDate END

select @MinDate,@MaxDate

Declare @ServerName varchar(30)=@0;
select (Case when @ServerName='DBP_DWA1\DWA1P' then 'PROD'
            ELSE 'TEST'
          
     END) As Environment

DECLARE @FILEDATE VARCHAR(200)=@FileDate;
INSERT INTO EXTRACT.[FL_3M_transmission]  (Table_Name,File_Date,Row_Count)
VALUES
('INPATIENT_CLAIM_HEADER',@FILEDATE,@RS_InPatientHeader)
,('OUTPATIENT_CLAIM_HEADER',@FILEDATE,@RS_OutPatientHeader)
,('INPATIENT_CLAIM_LINE',@FILEDATE,@RS_InPatientLine)
,('OUTPATIENT_CLAIM_LINE',@FILEDATE,@RS_OutPatientLine)
